title: Upper Signal Hill, Newcastle (approx.): faulty Milky Way pump, eight streets without water from about 11 Oct (resident), confirmed 17 Oct
summary: Residents of Upper Signal Hill in Newcastle (Amajuba District) were without water because of a faulty pump at the Milky Way pump station, Newcastle Municipality said in a statement on 17 October; its technical team was d...
story: Residents of Upper Signal Hill in Newcastle (Amajuba District) were without water because of a faulty pump at the Milky Way pump station, Newcastle Municipality said in a statement on 17 October; its technical team was doing emergency repairs and water tankers were to be sent to the affected streets: Capricorn, Star Crescent, Pisces, Meteor, Lunar, Gemini, Sun and Libra (Newcastle Advertiser, 17 October). A resident said they had been without water for six days, so since about 11 October, and that the part needed to fix the pump was out of stock. The start date rests on the resident's account; the municipality's statement gives no start date, so the pin date is 17 October, the day the fault was confirmed. When supply was restored is not in the saved report. One report. The pin is approximate: the Signal Hill suburb point, not the pump station or the streets.
incident: Without water since about Sun 11 Oct 2026 according to a resident (six days by 17 Oct); the municipality confirmed the faulty pump in a statement on Sat 17 Oct 2026 and gave no start date (Newcastle Advertiser). The pin date is 17 Oct.
